description: One row in a typed-step trace JSONL file. Used for anti-fraud verification: each tool_call must be matched by a tool_result; artifact steps must produce files that exist in the bundle with mtimes inside the run window.

artifact_id.description: For step_type=artifact: optional id matching execution.artifacts[].id.

artifact_path.description: For step_type=artifact: path inside bundle. File must exist with mtime in run window.

step_type.description: Step kind. tool_call+tool_result must pair via tool_call_id.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601. Must fall within execution.ran_at ± wall_time_s for anti-fraud verification.

tool_call_id.description: Required for step_type=tool_call and tool_result; must pair.

tool_output.description: Output for tool_result; same call_id as the matching tool_call.

title: ARM Trace Step v1
